findings.reason: RQ-01 permits operation through 50 km/h, while the feature catalog limits Synthetic_AEB to 40 km/h. The applicable operating boundary is inconsistent.
The requirement does not define how predicted-path intersection or TTC is calculated, including boundary conditions and validity of the prediction.
Collision path maintained is undefined, and the 150 ms timing reference point and measurement method are not specified.
Collision risk cleared is not operationally defined, so the required endpoint for maintaining the brake request is unclear.
Mandatory sensor input and invalidity criteria are unspecified, preventing an unambiguous determination of when automatic braking must be inhibited.
Sufficiently quickly and high collision risk have no quantitative thresholds, timing limits, or measurable acceptance criteria.
The trace explicitly provides no evidence artifact, so storage of scenario conditions, expected result, actual result, and Pass/Fail status cannot be assessed.
The trace entry has no allocated component, leaving RQ-12 without an accountable implementation or review-gate owner.
The contents of approval_audit.json are not supplied, so there is no inspectable evidence that an AI-generated test was not promoted to Approved without Human Review.
The cited review_findings.json is not supplied and no test result is provided, so compliance with the requirement's effectiveness claim cannot be assessed.
